notes:
Summary: Closed out as self-host decision. Stonepine evaluated Redwood hosted + Dedicated but elected to build on-prem stack (vLLM/TGI/TensorRT-LLM) to control cost and KMS/data residency.

Timeline / key bullets:
- 2024-08-12: inbound via doc-search quickstart, AE assigned (Maya). initial discovery call 2024-08-15 (CTO + infra lead).
- 2024-09-04: POC kickoff (2 week shot) — used sample telemetry ingestion and reranking flow (10k QPS target).
- 2024-09-18: Benchmarks: Redwood hosted latency med 55ms at 8k tokens/min vs on-prem prototype 48ms using TensorRT-LLM quantized runs. Cost model: infra-amortized looked 30-40% cheaper over 3 years per their finance.
- 2024-10-02: Security review: requested HSM/KMS diagrams, detailed audit log schema, and network isolation for on-prem. Our security FAQ shared (drive link).
- 2024-10-12: Demo of Dedicated offering + canary rollout. They liked autoscale but flagged long-term cost.
- 2024-11-05: Final decision meeting with CTO. Quote: "We need absolute control over the KV cache, encryption keys, and the ability to tune kernels — we'll self-host."
- 2024-11-22: AE notes: official procurement freeze lifted but leadership pushed for self-host to leverage existing GPU pool and internal infra team. Closed as lost.

POC specifics / buyer motivations:
- Primary: cost control, data residency, and low-level kernel tuning for latency predictability.
- Workloads: real-time reranking for telemetry alerts + chat ops assistant for NOC. Need for <75ms tail latency for single-turn queries during bursts.
- Security: required on-prem KMS + SOC2-level audit trails; unwilling to accept hosted KMS model.
- Ops: heavy preference for integration with existing Prometheus/Thanos stacks and local HSM.

Why they left / competitor rationale:
- Existing infra team prefers owning stack (vLLM/TGI + TensorRT) to squeeze cost and control. Internal estimates show 3-year TCO advantage when amortizing GPUs.
- No single internal champion to negotiate an enterprise package with Redwood; procurement prioritized internal build.
- Budget constraints for enterprise onboarding fee + support bundle made Dedicated less attractive.

Follow-up playbook / open items:
- Mark as closed-lost; add to 6-month re-engage cadence.
- Send self-host migration guide and cost comparison template (tailored) to CTO and infra lead.
- Offer 3-month trial of Redwood Private with reduced onboarding fee if they hit scalability pain.

Stenography / CRM notes (fragments):
- "like control over KV cache" — CTO (10/12)
- Fireflies call 2024-09-04 reference for POC kickoff
- Infra lead wants kernel-level tuning, citing Tensor cores + TRT perf
- Finance ran 3-yr TCO conservative model -> favors self-host
- AE recommends MVP partnership: small managed private instance as re-entry path
